name: runbook-k8s-scale
description: Scale a Kubernetes deployment or statefulset to a number of replicas within guard rails: a baseline (replicas, usage against requests and limits, an HPA that would undo it, the inventory's min/max), human approval, the scale with k8s_control (it refuses anything outside the guard rails, more than 3x at once, or a workload an HPA manages, and waits for the replicas), then verification.

workload.description: deployment/<name> or statefulset/<name> (or leave empty and give service).

service.description: An inventory service with a k8s mapping.

cluster.description: The inventory cluster (empty: the service's, or the only one).

precheck.title: Pre-checks (baseline and guard rails)
precheck.prompt:
Pre-checks for scaling {{input.workload}} {{input.service}} (namespace {{input.namespace}}, cluster {{input.cluster}}) to {{input.replicas}} replicas (reason: {{input.reason}}). Read-only: k8s_health for the workload (replicas now, availability, events), k8s_metrics for it (usage against requests and limits: does more replicas help, or is it something else?), k8s_describe of an HPA that targets it if there is one (a manual scale would be undone), and ops_inventory show for the service and cluster (min_replicas/max_replicas, scale).

Report: replicas now -> {{input.replicas}}, the guard rails and whether {{input.replicas}} is within them, whether an HPA manages it, whether nodes have room (Pending pods after scaling up are a risk), and whether scaling is likely to help.

approve.title: Approve the scale

scale.title: Scale
scale.prompt:
A person approved scaling {{input.workload}} {{input.service}} (namespace {{input.namespace}}, cluster {{input.cluster}}) to {{input.replicas}} replicas. Run k8s_control once with action scale, that target and replicas {{input.replicas}}, reason "{{input.reason}}", and nothing else. If it refuses (guard rails, an HPA), do not try another way: report the refusal.

Report: the tool's before/after output.

verify.title: Verify
verify.prompt:
Verify the scale of {{input.workload}} {{input.service}} to {{input.replicas}}.

Baseline:
{{state.precheck}}

Scale result:
{{state.scale}}

Read-only: k8s_health for the workload ({{input.replicas}} replicas wanted and that many available, no Pending pods, no new warning events) and ops_check for its service if it has one. VERIFIED when it runs {{input.replicas}} available replicas and nothing is worse; otherwise FAILED (a refused scale is FAILED: nothing changed).

Report: the checks and their numbers.
